description: Header file defining the TunerAdministrator singleton class, which manages tuner instances and notifications within a broadcast system. It includes nested classes, callback interfaces, and methods for registration, deregistration, and state management of tuners.

classes.name: TunerAdministrator
classes.description: Singleton class managing tuner instances and observer notifications within the broadcast system.

classes.name: TunerAdministrator::ICallback
classes.description: Interface for callback objects to receive tuner state change notifications.

classes.name: TunerAdministrator::Sink
classes.description: Private nested class implementing ICallback, used internally to handle state change callbacks.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of TunerAdministrator.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers an observer for tuner notifications and notifies it of current tuners.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Removes an observer from the notification list.

methods.name: Announce
methods.description: Registers a new tuner and returns a callback object for state change notifications.

methods.name: Revoke
methods.description: Removes a tuner from management and notifies observers.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Internal method to notify observers of a tuner state change.
